dispositions.name: in_stock
dispositions.question: Did the shopkeeper say the requested item ({{item}}) is available in the requested quantity ({{quantity}})?

objective_options.condition: The shopkeeper clearly said they have the item in at least the requested quantity.
The shopkeeper has the item but only in a smaller quantity, or only with a condition such as paying an advance.
The shopkeeper clearly said the item is not available.
Availability was not asked, not answered, or the answer was unclear.

dispositions.name: unit_price_inr
dispositions.question: What price for ONE unit, in rupees, did the shopkeeper explicitly say? Answer with the number only, for example 270. If the shopkeeper did not say a per-unit price, answer null. Never estimate or calculate a price.

dispositions.name: total_price_inr
dispositions.question: What TOTAL price, in rupees, did the shopkeeper explicitly say for the whole requested quantity ({{quantity}})? Number only. If no total was said, answer null. Never estimate or calculate a price.

dispositions.name: price_unit
dispositions.question: If the shopkeeper said a per-unit price, which unit was it for: piece, packet, kg, g, litre, ml, strip, bottle, box, dozen or metre? Answer with that one word, or null if no unit was said.

dispositions.name: qty_available
dispositions.question: How many units did the shopkeeper say they have available? Number only. If no number was said, answer null.

dispositions.name: brand_or_variant
dispositions.question: Which brand, size or variant did the shopkeeper say they have? A few words only, or null if it was not mentioned.

dispositions.name: pickup_or_delivery
dispositions.question: Did the shopkeeper say the customer should pick the item up, or offer to deliver it?

objective_options.condition: Pickup at the shop was said or agreed.
The shopkeeper offered to deliver it.
Pickup or delivery was not discussed, or it is unclear.

dispositions.name: ready_in_minutes
dispositions.question: In how many minutes did the shopkeeper say the item will be ready for the customer? Convert hours to minutes (one hour = 60). If they said it is ready now, answer 0. Number only. If no time, or only a vague time such as 'soon' or 'sometime today', was said, answer null.

dispositions.name: can_hold
dispositions.question: Did the shopkeeper explicitly agree to keep the item aside for this customer?

objective_options.condition: The shopkeeper clearly agreed to keep or reserve the item for the customer.
The shopkeeper said they cannot keep it aside.
Holding was not asked, or the answer was vague, such as 'we will try' or 'come and see'.

dispositions.name: opt_out
dispositions.question: Did the shopkeeper ask not to be called again, or to be removed from the list?

objective_options.condition: The shopkeeper asked not to receive any more calls.
The shopkeeper did not ask to stop calls.

dispositions.name: stock_quote
dispositions.question: Copy the shopkeeper's exact words about whether the item ({{item}}) is available, verbatim, in the original language and script, at most 25 words. Copy only words the shopkeeper said, never the assistant's, and never translate, summarise or correct them. Answer null if the shopkeeper said nothing about availability.

dispositions.name: notes
dispositions.question: In one short sentence, note any condition the shopkeeper mentioned, such as an advance payment or a time after which the item will be available. Answer null if there was none.

dispositions.name: alt_available
dispositions.question: The requested item ({{item}}) was a medicine brand. Did the shopkeeper say they have ANOTHER brand with the same composition ({{alternative}})? Having {{item}} itself does not count.

objective_options.condition: The shopkeeper said they have a different brand with the same salt, strength and form.
The shopkeeper said they do not have another brand with the same composition.
Another brand was not asked about or not offered, or the answer was unclear.

dispositions.name: alt_brand
dispositions.question: If the shopkeeper said they have another brand with the same composition, which brand or company name did they say? The name only, as said. Answer null if they did not name one or did not offer another brand.

dispositions.name: alt_price_inr
dispositions.question: If the shopkeeper said a price for that other brand, what TOTAL price in rupees did they say for {{quantity}} of it? Number only. Answer null if no price was said for the other brand. Never estimate or calculate a price.
